dev_alex: Quick repro I made that shows different bundlers resolving the SDK to different builds and failing in edge shims (Cloudflare/Netlify). Posting the minimal steps + observed failure modes.

maria: paste the repo + exact commands please.

dev_alex: repo: github.com/redwood-inference/repro-bundler-compat (branch alex/bundle-fail). Minimal package.json has an exports map with browser/import/require. src/index.ts just imports createClient and logs. Commands: npm ci && npm run build:vite|rollup|webpack then run with miniflare (for CF).

Observed: 
- Vite (esbuild deps): resolves to the browser file which still references process -> miniflare runtime: ReferenceError: process is not defined.
- Rollup (+@rollup/plugin-commonjs): build succeeds but runtime: TypeError: createClient is not a function (default interop mismatch).
- Webpack: picks require path and includes small node-helper that references __dirname -> ReferenceError: __dirname is not defined in edge.

sam: short workarounds that helped locally: alias 'redwood-inference' -> 'redwood-inference/dist/index.esm.js' for vite, set rollup commonjs requireReturnsDefault:'namespace' and add resolve.exportConditions:['import','default'], for webpack set resolve.conditionNames=['import','default'] + DefinePlugin for process.env and fallbacks for node builtins.

maria: long-term SDK fixes we should track in the issue: publish an explicit edge-only ESM entry (exports.edge), ship top-level types file (types/index.d.ts), and provide a simple import path like 'redwood-inference/edge' that consumers can opt into. Also mark sideEffects:false to help bundlers.

lee: CI note: PR #1412 triggered ci/bundler-matrix and webpack+netlify-edge tests failed. Filing a small CI task to run the minimal sample in a matrix so we catch regressions.

ci-bot: CI job failed (PR #1412) - ci/bundler-matrix - see internal logs.

dev_alex: I've opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/312 with the repo, exact logs, and a simple patch proposal. Will draft a short devex doc listing per-bundler repro and quick fixes. If anyone can review the PR (adds dist/esm-entry.mjs + types at root) that'd be great.
